protocol.decision: two-seed diagnostic screen only; below-gate is not a six-run pass
protocol.prior: same truth-informed WP8 hard-case calibration in all four interventions

remove_observed_clutter.intervention: remove seven clutter points; set Poisson mean 0.45 to 0.15

complete_true_detections.intervention: restore every missed true localization; set detection p 0.65 to 0.95

widen_crossing.intervention: increase midpoint spacing 0.006 to 0.010 mm with identical noise and clutter

wp7_existence_schedule.intervention: switch to the 20-slot-frame WP7 mask; drop now-inactive true detections
